# Bhutan (BTN) - notes (accessed 2026-10-18)

Source: Royal Bhutan Police statistical yearbooks, download page https://rbp.gov.bt/pages/download-and-archives/ (yearbooks 2017-2025 listed).

- rows.csv holds counts of criminal incidents by dzongkhag (20 dzongkhags) for 2017, 2018, 2019 and 2020, plus the national total ("country" rows) as printed. Every row was checked: the 20 dzongkhag values add up to the published Total.
- 2017-2019: all rows of the "Homicide" group in the "offences against the person by Dzongkhag" table were kept, as published - this group also contains Illegal Abortion, Custodial Death, Complicity in Suicide, Illegal Selling/Buying of Human Organs and Trafficking a Person, and the group Total includes them. Measure labels keep the spelling of each year's table (e.g. "Criminal Attempt Murder" in 2017).
- 2020: Table 2.8 is an alphabetical list without groups; only rows with murder / manslaughter / homicide / custodial death in the label were taken (7 rows incl. "Aiding and abetting for criminal attempt to voluntary manslaughter"). No "Criminal attempt to murder" row was found in that table. The other homicide-group offences (illegal abortion etc.) were not taken for 2020.
- Dzongkhag names are as printed and differ between years (Chukha/Chhukha/Chukkha, T/Gang/Trashigang/Tashigang, Wangdue/Wangduephodrang, Lhuntse/Lhuentse, Pema Gatshel/Pemagatshel, Samdrup Jongkhar/Samdrupjongkhar). They need matching to one list before mapping.
- 2021-2025 yearbooks (SYB-2021, CRIME-STATS-YEARBOOK-2022-FINAL, RBPStatisticalYearbok2023, Statistical-Yearbook-2024, Statistical-Yearbook-2025-1) were downloaded. In them, murder appears only in national tables (by month, by year, by age of arrested persons); the dzongkhag tables give totals (all crime, violent crime, property crime, crime severity index), not offence types. Nationally, 2025 Table A1.9 gives Murder incidents 2/1/4/4/1 for 2021-2025 - national only, not put in rows.csv.
- Unit is "criminal incidents", not victims.
- No licence or terms of use were seen on the download page.
- NSB Statistical Yearbook (nsb.gov.bt) and Dzongkhag statistics were not opened.
